newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast products prices stay flat.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast products prices stay flat.

text.p: U.S. West Coast products stayed flat on late Friday as players remained on the sidelines.
November NYMEX unleaded gasoline closed five cents lower at 63.63 cents a gallon, tracking a technical correction in heating oil.
Heating oil lost 0.26 cent on Friday to end 74.43 cents a gallon, as profit-taking curbed early week rallies.
Prices for low sulphur diesel in Los Angeles stayed 70/71 cents a gallon in late trading.
Jet fuel in L.A. stood at 70/71 cents a gallon and San Francisco jet was the same price.
CARB diesel was also even with Thursday's levels, ending at 82/83 cents.
Gasoline out west was flat. Bids for L.A. conventional regular grade were 64.50/66 cents a gallon.
CARB-grade gasoline in L.A. remained at 70/71 cents a gallon.
